call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one finished Korean online recruitment poster, portrait 2:3, one flat canvas.
Primary request: recruit for a cooperative beach cleanup with every exact supplied item visible once. This is one independent new poster. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Organizing relationship: a close cooperative pickup TRANSFER organizes the poster on one continuous pale sandy plane. Show exactly two cropped gloved hands and short forearm portions, without full people or faces. A hand enters from the upper-left edge and firmly operates the trigger grip of a real litter picker. One continuous metal shaft runs diagonally toward the upper-right-middle and ends in two clearly connected rubber gripping jaws. Those jaws visibly clasp the middle of a dirty, crumpled transparent plastic bottle. The bottle is being lowered partly into the open mouth of a collection bag. The second hand enters from the right edge, grasps the folded bag rim and holds the opening wide beside and below the jaws. Make the hand-grip, shaft-to-jaw connection, jaw-to-bottle pressure, bottle entering the bag and hand-to-bag rim contact explicit and mechanically credible. Only two hands; no extra disembodied fingers. The bottle has sand and scuffs, no label or lettering. A translucent subdued teal collection bag has a thin folded rim, believable mouth depth and material tension caused by the hand.

Rendering: documentary close-up photography with tactile natural materials and precise editorial typography. Real woven work gloves with light sand stains, matte brushed metal, dull rubber jaws, scratched clear plastic, thin translucent bag film and granular sand. Diffuse daylight, restrained natural color, coherent contact shadows. The illustration is not a cheerful staged volunteer portrait. The small sandy shore context includes a few damp pebbles and a narrow soft wet-sand edge near the action; no panoramic sea, horizon or expansive scenic background. Do not create a photo panel: sand and the quiet warm off-white field continue seamlessly through the whole poster, with granular detail restricted to the actual action area and clean low-contrast negative ground for copy.

Composition and typography: the diagonal tool shaft and the open bag form a single asymmetrical large gesture, with the hands cropped intentionally at canvas edges. Below and alongside the shaft, the negative triangle on the left holds a bold deep-navy Korean title as a compact three-line shape. Let its short final line turn the eye toward the transfer point; retain complete words and clear word spaces. The recruitment line sits close to the title at a smaller substantial size. The action is at close scale on the upper-right and extends into the same continuous space as the type. The full application sentence is an EARLY plain navy text block immediately near the title/recruitment reading point, well above the lower operational text. Set its deadline portion and complete URL prominently, allow a word-boundary wrap after the colon, and retain the URL intact on one readable line. No button, colored band, badge, underline decoration or footer treatment for registration.

Use the remaining continuous negative area to group appointment and location, then eligibility/provided equipment/personal preparation, then weather and cost/certificate conditions. Use only the existing wording and whitespace to show these relationships; no new group headers, rules, icons or labels. Arrange line lengths around the action's clear silhouette without placing any copy on the hand, tool, bottle or bag. The lower information must be a deliberate spacious composition rather than compressed fine print. Use one strong Korean sans-serif family with carefully matched Latin/numeral weight and baselines. The title is large, the application block conspicuous, the date and place substantial, and all conditions comfortable to read at a 720px wide on-screen display. Preserve generous margins, steady line spacing and clear contrast. The contact remains a visible separate plain line.

Complete artwork copy, each item exactly once, preserving spelling, all word spaces, punctuation, numerals, dates and the entire URL. These twelve items may be meaningfully regrouped; wrapping at existing word boundaries is allowed. Quotation marks below are delimiters and must not print:
“우리 바다, 함께 줍는 토요일”
“하람 해변 정화 참여자 모집”
“2026년 11월 21일 토요일”
“오전 9시 30분 집결 · 낮 12시 종료”
“하람시 물결마당 앞 · 파도길 8”
“대상: 만 14세 이상 누구나 · 선착순 40명”
“집게와 수거 봉투는 제공됩니다.”
“개인 장갑, 마실 물, 모자를 준비해 주세요.”
“우천 시 취소되며 신청자에게 전날 문자로 안내합니다.”
“참가비 무료 · 봉사 확인서는 발급하지 않습니다.”
“11월 18일까지 신청: haram-wave.example/join”
“문의: 바다정화 운영팀”

Constraints: exact portrait 2:3 edge-to-edge flat poster. Every item must remain fully visible and readable. No full-width top-heading/hero-panel/footer-band scaffolding, no scenic panorama, no smiling posed people, no separated image cards, no panel border or frame, no mockup, no variant collage. No invented copy, extra headings, decorative marks, logo, numbering, text-bearing icon, watermark, QR code or fake microtext. No repeated title or URL. No melted anatomy, doubled tong shafts, disconnected jaws, hovering bottle, falsely sealed bag, ornamental waves, artificial shine, glow or distressed text. Real dirty pickup contact, clear readable type and the continuous spatial relationship are the priorities.

residuals: Application block is readable at 720px but less typographically dominant than date/recruitment.
Exact tong pressure and the cropped rim-gripping finger arrangement remain limited-view uncertainties.
Lower copy remains mostly left aligned with hierarchy partly carried by whitespace.
Full small copy and URL are not comfortably readable at the 213px-wide thumbnail.
